structured_result.summary: Independent synthesis after incomplete Meeting Room close (D8: Codex and Grok reviewers absent; Claude completed both rounds). The withheld compound product question is disaggregated: frozen packs do not corroborate adopting ChatGPT-style conversation-first mobile as a unit. Strongest grounded split is companion partition plus glanceable status/alarm separation: mobile as decision-and-deferral (approve/stop/glance, consent grain, reattach), named places as shared-picture stations rather than hamburger orphans, conversation as exception/blocker channel rather than home, raw xterm desktop-only. Conversation-first is an imported metaphor facing a first-class missing-conversation-lineage gap across all 51 seeds. Derived-field convergence (reattach/handover; consent grain; faithful trace) is treated as stronger than exemplar unanimity, which the meeting marks as a coverage-floor artifact. Cross-domain links X1–X13 remain typed candidates, not adopted. Dissent preserved. Web verification not run. Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms are cited only as question-named surfaces, not adopted product ontology.

predicted_paths.name: Companion partition: mobile decision-and-deferral, desktop evidence/xterm
predicted_paths.thesis: Universe mobile for long-running agents is a notification/companion surface: glance, acknowledge, approve/deny/stop, or escalate. Authoring, faithful traces, and raw xterm stay on desktop. Conversation is a narrow exception channel, not the home object.
predicted_paths.mobile_home_surface: glanceable status plus consent cards; not a ChatGPT transcript
predicted_paths.conversation_role: blocking asks, notify-and-proceed, and escalation etiquette only
predicted_paths.named_places_goal_fleet_galaxy_rooms: reachable stations for ownership/evidence, not hamburger-only; cited as question-named surfaces only
predicted_paths.why_this_path: Desktop-mobile continuity seeds across all three packs describe notification-as-remote-control and safe handoff without pretending the small surface contains full context. Command-line job-control seeds treat captured stdout as proof, which is a large-surface evidence job.

predicted_paths.name: Conversation-first bundle as asked
predicted_paths.thesis: Mobile home is a ChatGPT-style stream; Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms/status live behind a top menu; only approvals/blockers enter the stream; raw xterm is desktop-only.
predicted_paths.why_this_path: SMS/keyword-reply and two-person-rule seeds can be read as supporting compact consent in a message channel. This path is the imported product metaphor. Meeting claim: missing conversation seed across all 51 seeds is a first-class gap for a conversational-agent question, so P2 is hypothesized, not pack-corroborated.

predicted_paths.name: Overview-first control room: alarm separated from status
predicted_paths.thesis: Concurrent long-running agents will alarm-flood a conversation home. Mobile home is an overview with a small fixed status vocabulary; demand-for-action is a distinct channel; conversation is one station among rooms, not the shared picture.
predicted_paths.conversation_role: one station for protocol/readback and exception talk, not health
predicted_paths.named_places_goal_fleet_galaxy_rooms: spatial stations (rooms vs threads) that change who sees state and who may speak
predicted_paths.xterm_locus: desktop or expert drilldown, not the glance surface
predicted_paths.why_this_path: Dashboard/control-room, graphic glanceable-status, industrial cockpit mode-readability, architecture war-room/control-room-place, and multi-agent handoff/readback seeds converge on overview-plus-override rather than utterance-first control.

predicted_paths.name: Delegation envelopes: staffed watch versus unattended batch as opposite operating modes
predicted_paths.thesis: Autonomy UI is a delegation envelope (silent / report / ask), not a chat persona. Staffed-watch (mission-control handover) and unattended-batch (submit/detach/reattach) are opposite answers to the same timesharing tension. A single conversation-first home collapses both.
predicted_paths.mobile_home_surface: mode-readable envelope: watch board OR batch inbox, never mixed undifferentiated tokens
predicted_paths.conversation_role: periodic reporting and exception escalation, not per-action narration
predicted_paths.named_places_goal_fleet_galaxy_rooms: authority and ownership places; burial hides the chain of consent
predicted_paths.xterm_locus: desktop evidence for batch jobs; not a live watch channel
predicted_paths.why_this_path: Social-delegation, long-running monitoring, timesharing batch-versus-interactive, approvals consent-grain, and push/battery interruption-budget seeds. X5 is a post-share candidate interpretation linking staffed watch to unattended batch as opposites, not one lineage.

predicted_paths.name: Inspectable-state first: reattach to jobs/objects, transcript as evidence not control plane
predicted_paths.thesis: Long-running agents need a durable inspectable state surface (jobs, cells, objects) that survives chat turns. Conversation-first hides work objects and substitutes persuasive narrative for faithful trace, which fails after surprise.
predicted_paths.mobile_home_surface: reattachable job/object list with heartbeat and ownership
predicted_paths.conversation_role: on-demand justification and override talk beside the object, not instead of it
predicted_paths.named_places_goal_fleet_galaxy_rooms: if they are the object graph, they cannot be details-on-demand only; progressive disclosure still requires the object to be findable
predicted_paths.xterm_locus: desktop expert inspect of stdout/trace; mobile gets summary plus escalate
predicted_paths.why_this_path: Direct-manipulation visibility/reversibility, Grok notebook edit-run-inspect, command-line job control, trust/audit/override-after-surprise, progressive-disclosure details-on-demand, and long-run reattach seeds. Derived-field meeting claim: reattach/handover and faithful trace beat exemplar unanimity.

challenge_to_conversation_first_ui.claim: Conversation-first is the wrong primary mobile frame for long-running autonomous agents.
arguments: Work is mostly invisible and non-spatial; HCI direct-manipulation seeds say the visibility-and-reversibility promise must be re-earned by other means than pointing—or than uttering. Hiding work objects behind chat loses the recognition path.
Dashboards/alarm seeds: many concurrent agents generate alarm flood unless status and demand-for-action are separated. A ChatGPT stream recodes both as messages.
Accessibility linearization and SMS-constraint seeds: serial channels have high interruption cost; the real requirement is 'what changed since I last listened,' not an ever-growing transcript.
Industrial cockpit seeds: autonomous vs supervised and dry-run vs live must be readable from the surface, not from conversational memory. Silent mode changes recreate classic mode errors.

Architecture-spatial seeds: several agents still need a single place where the shared picture lives and where authority to commit is visible. Burying Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms/status behind a top menu is the opposite of that place.
Trust/explainability seeds: a faithful trace earns trust differently from a persuasive narrative; the difference matters most after surprise. Conversation-first biases toward narrative.

Meeting claim: missing conversation lineage across all 51 seeds is a first-class gap. The ChatGPT home is an imported metaphor, not a pack-grounded interaction form. Coverage-floor (17 seeds, one per lineage) makes any apparent agreement on chat-like exemplars a weak corroboration.
challenge_to_conversation_first_ui.does_not_defeat: Using conversation as a narrow consent/exception channel (approvals/blockers, keyword-scale replies) remains compatible with P1/P3/P4. The challenge is to conversation-as-home and to burial of status/places, not to talking at all.

risks.text: Mixing health, progress, retries, and blockers in one transcript recreates alarm flood and hides the blocking item.
Unread mode plus silent consent on a push channel yields missable high-impact actions; notification shade can become an adversarial consent channel (post-share candidate X3, not adopted).
Work that outlives a session fails if re-entry is scrollback rather than explicit handover/reattach language.
Always-on agents spend from a shared attention-and-power budget they do not control; conversation-first encourages over-narration.
After surprise, a confident summary without recoverable evidence/override/audit trail produces false trust.
Progressive disclosure fails when the buried Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms/status layer is the true control plane.
D8: advancing to prediction with 2/3 meeting reviewers absent is not a full cross-review. Synthesis confidence is capped by missing Codex/Grok meeting turns.
One seed per lineage × 17 makes exemplar agreement a method artifact (D1 amended). Do not treat chat-like wording overlap as independent votes for conversation-first.
Adopting question-named Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms as product ontology would violate non-adoption of Goals/Todos; they remain labels in the withheld question.
Treating X3/X5/X8 as settled causes would flatten typed candidate interpretations into chronology.

Exemplar convergence is a method artifact of the 17-seed coverage floor; R1–R3 derived-field convergence (reattach/handover; consent grain; faithful trace) is not the same claim and is not flattened into exemplar unanimity.
Schema/self-attestation mismatch on Claude LOW-to-MEDIUM uncertainty is unresolved and is not used to upgrade or downgrade pack weight.

This reviewer treats P2 (conversation-first bundle) as a live rival path with low pack grounding, not as a meeting-adopted recommendation. No vendor meeting majority exists to contradict because Codex and Grok did not complete.

smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.procedure: Build two otherwise identical mobile shells for one long-running dual-agent scenario. Shell A: ChatGPT-style transcript home, Goal/Fleet/Galaxy/Rooms/status behind a top menu, blocker cards inline. Shell B: persistent glanceable status rail plus separate blocker inbox; conversation is a tab. Same approval grammar. Measure time-to-notice a silent failure, time-to-approve a blocking ask, and mis-taps of status-as-alarm.
smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.smallest_because: Holds consent cards constant; varies only home-surface.

smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.procedure: Four-hour away-from-phone handover. On return, task is to answer 'what changed, who owns it, what is blocked.' Shell A: scroll the transcript. Shell B: reattach summary (delta, ownership, heartbeat) with trace one gesture away.
smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.smallest_because: Tests the meeting derived-field 'reattach/handover' without adding new ontology.

smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.procedure: Three-grain consent drill: silent, notify-and-proceed, hard block. Inject one missable high-impact action into the notification shade versus an in-app blocking card. Count misses, false proceeds, and whether users can state the current mode without memory.
smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.smallest_because: Isolates consent grain and cockpit mode-readability; X3 remains a candidate explanation if shade-consent underperforms.

smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.procedure: Two concurrent agents, one healthy-retrying and one failed. User may not open the top menu for 30 seconds. Success = distinguish status from alarm from the first screen. Failure = burial/conversation-home hypothesis.
Hung job requiring stdout. Mobile-only xterm versus 'escalate to desktop' affordance. Measure completion, error, and whether users treat stdout as proof.
smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.smallest_because: Tests xterm reservation without assuming chat-home.

smallest_discriminating_prototypes_or_us.procedure: Screen-reader pass: sequential navigation plus 'announce what changed since last listen.' Conversation-only cards fail if deltas are not queryable independently of visual layout.
